premises.text: Businesses struggle with manual accounts payable processes due to complexity and disconnection among functions
premises.evidence_span: the vast majority of businesses cannot execute these fundamental steps

premises.text: Makers Hub enables customers to connect disparate accounts payable processes and capture data without manual entry
premises.evidence_span: We enable our customers to connect their disparate account payable processes, to capture all of their data with no manual entry

premises.text: Makers Hub provides real-time job costing and enhances collaboration across organizations
premises.evidence_span: We've enabled real-time job costing for their project managers and enhanced the collaboration across this organization

premises.text: Makers Hub extracts over 50,000 data points from bills to improve data reconciliation
premises.evidence_span: we extract more than 50,000 data points from every page, the characters and their relation to one another

premises.text: Makers Hub uses deterministic language models to refine data reconciliation
premises.evidence_span: expose that partially reconciled data to a series of deterministic language models that help us put a finer point on that reconciliation

premises.text: Users can approve bills and schedule payments easily through the Makers Hub system
premises.evidence_span: a single click approves the bill, auto-creates the associated record in the accounting system, and loads the next bill in the queue

value.text: Makers Hub improves efficiency and confidence in financial operations for businesses
value.evidence_span: The result for Trey is a more efficient workforce, better data for the organization, and greater confidence in his financial operations

notes: Customer count, fundraising, and demo offer excluded as traction.
